0022600164.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-6, on a six-game losing streak and 15th in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (4-2, on a three-game winning streak and 6th in the West) in the Kings' seventh game of the season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Kings won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 130-121 win in Dallas on February 26, 2026.
